title: MPK: A Compiler and Runtime for Mega-Kernelizing Tensor Programs
authors: Xinhao Cheng; Zhihao Zhang; Yu Zhou; Jianan Ji; Jinchen Jiang; Zepeng Zhao; Ziruo Xiao; Zihao Ye; Yingyi Huang; Ruihang Lai; Hongyi Jin; Bohan Hou; Mengdi Wu; Yixin Dong; Anthony Yip; Songting Wang; Wenqin Yang; Xupeng Miao; Tianqi Chen; Zhihao Jia
venue_full: USENIX Symposium on Operating Systems Design and Implementation (OSDI '26)
research_focus: LLM serving, Roofline analysis, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design, Collective communication

problem_statement.en: The conventional kernel-per-operator execution model launches a separate GPU kernel for every operator in an LLM decoding step. Each launch incurs CPU dispatch/launch overhead and, more importantly, forces every intermediate tensor to be written out to and re-read from HBM between kernels. For low-latency single-request decoding the model is weight-roofline bound (e.g. loading ~16 GB of weights at 1.6 TB/s implies a ~10 ms floor), and these inter-kernel HBM round-trips plus launch/scheduling overhead keep real latency well above that hardware limit.
problem_statement.zh: 傳統的 kernel-per-operator 執行模型會為 LLM decode 每一步的每個 operator 各自啟動一個 GPU kernel。每次啟動都帶來 CPU dispatch/launch 額外負擔，更關鍵的是迫使所有中間張量在 kernel 之間被寫回並重新從 HBM 讀取。對於低延遲的單請求 decode，效能受 weight-roofline 限制（例如以 1.6 TB/s 載入約 16 GB 權重意味著約 10 ms 的下限），而這些 inter-kernel 的 HBM 往返加上 launch/排程開銷使實際延遲遠高於該硬體極限。

key_innovation.en: MPK is a compiler+runtime that compiles an entire multi-GPU LLM inference step into a single persistent mega-kernel. The compiler lowers the tensor program into an SM-level task graph that captures data dependencies at the granularity of individual streaming multiprocessors and generates fast CUDA code per task; an in-kernel parallel runtime then executes the whole graph inside one persistent kernel launch using decentralized scheduling across SMs (workers + local/remote schedulers). Because all operators run inside one kernel, intermediate results stay in on-chip SRAM/L2 / registers and are handed off worker-to-worker instead of round-tripping through HBM, which also enables cross-operator software pipelining and fine-grained overlap of computation with inter-GPU communication.
key_innovation.zh: MPK 是一套編譯器加執行期系統，能把整個多 GPU 的 LLM 推理步驟編譯成單一 persistent mega-kernel。編譯器將張量程式下降為 SM-level task graph，以個別串流多處理器（SM）的粒度捕捉資料相依性，並為每個 task 產生高效 CUDA 程式；in-kernel 平行 runtime 接著在單一 persistent kernel 啟動內，以跨 SM 的去中心化排程（workers 加 local/remote schedulers）執行整張圖。由於所有 operator 都在同一個 kernel 內運行，中間結果留在晶片上的 SRAM/L2／暫存器並以 worker 對 worker 的方式傳遞，而非往返 HBM；這同時實現了跨 operator 的 software pipelining 與計算/跨 GPU 通訊的細粒度重疊。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (target is the weight-loading roofline bound: MPK reaches 12.5 ms single-GPU decode vs a ~10 ms theoretical floor for 16 GB weights at 1.6 TB/s)

scope_assumptions.en: Targets low-latency, small-batch (single-request) autoregressive decoding where the step is weight-roofline (memory-bandwidth) bound; the megakernel is built per fixed model/shape configuration ahead of time. Multi-GPU gains assume NVLink/NVSHMEM intra-node communication. Reported analysis floors assume weights dominate HBM traffic and ignore KV-cache growth for long contexts.
scope_assumptions.zh: 針對低延遲、小批次（單請求）的自迴歸 decode，此時每步受 weight-roofline（記憶體頻寬）限制；mega-kernel 是針對固定模型/形狀組態事先編譯產生。多 GPU 的增益假設使用 NVLink/NVSHMEM 的節點內通訊。所報告的分析下限假設權重主導 HBM 流量，並忽略長上下文下 KV-cache 的成長。

baselines_compared: kernel-per-operator execution, vLLM, SGLang, Triton kernels, FlashInfer, CUDA Graphs

key_improvements.en: Eliminating inter-kernel HBM round-trips is the central contribution: by fusing the whole step into one persistent kernel, intermediates stay on-chip (SRAM/L2/registers) instead of being written to and re-read from HBM between operators, and per-operator launch/dispatch overhead is removed. The arXiv abstract reports up to 1.7x lower end-to-end inference latency vs kernel-per-operator serving systems, pushing single-request decode close to the hardware limit; the project's earlier MPK report quotes a 1.2x-6.7x latency reduction with gains growing with GPU count, e.g. single-GPU A100-40GB decode of 12.5 ms (MPK) vs 14.5 ms (kernel-per-operator) against a ~10 ms weight-roofline floor (16 GB weights / 1.6 TB/s).
key_improvements.zh: 消除 inter-kernel 的 HBM 往返是核心貢獻：藉由把整步融合進單一 persistent kernel，中間結果留在晶片上（SRAM/L2／暫存器）而非在 operator 之間寫回並重讀 HBM，同時移除每個 operator 的 launch/dispatch 開銷。arXiv 摘要回報相較 kernel-per-operator 服務系統最高降低 1.7x 的端到端推理延遲，使單請求 decode 逼近硬體極限；專案先前的 MPK 報告則引述 1.2x-6.7x 的延遲降低，且增益隨 GPU 數量上升，例如單 GPU A100-40GB 的 decode 為 12.5 ms（MPK）對 14.5 ms（kernel-per-operator），相對於約 10 ms 的 weight-roofline 下限（16 GB 權重／1.6 TB/s）。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 40GB, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H200, NVIDIA B200, HBM, NVLink
gpu_count: 1-8x A100/H100 (single-node, gains grow with GPU count)

source.notes: L2/inter-kernel cache reuse is the load-bearing mechanism: fusing the whole decode step into one persistent megakernel keeps intermediates on-chip (SRAM/L2/registers) and removes inter-kernel HBM round-trips + launch overhead, leaving latency bounded by the weight-loading roofline.
